landing.eyebrow: Free · runs right in your browser
landing.headline: Cut videos people
landing.tagline: Jelly Cut is a simple video editor for school and fun. No account, no install. Your videos never leave your device.
landing.ctaHint: One click and you are in.

mock.label: Animated preview of the editor: clips slide onto the timeline, a sticker pops in and a wipe moves to the next scene.

features.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
features.intro: A toolbox without the clutter that still looks really good.

cut.title: Cut & trim
cut.text: Split clips at exactly the right spot and drop the dead air.

text.title: Text & stickers
text.text: Titles and speech bubbles that pop in with some bounce.

transitions.title: Transitions & filters
transitions.text: Wipe, fade or change the colours for the right vibe.

blur.title: Hide things
blur.text: Blur faces or names before you share anything.

record.title: Record
record.text: Capture your screen or your voice right inside the editor.

export.title: Export
export.text: Save as MP4 or GIF, ready for a presentation, a chat or the school portal.

privacy.title: Private from the start
privacy.text: Jelly Cut has no server for your videos. Everything happens in your browser, on your device.
privacy.art: A device with a padlock. The cloud next to it is crossed out, because nothing gets uploaded.

browser.title: No installation
browser.text: Runs in the browser, even on school computers without admin rights.

guide.title: Sources & law
guide.text: Find free music and pictures and learn what is allowed.

final.title: Ready for your first video?
final.text: The editor is waiting. Open it and get going.
